reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, round-2 fix-verification batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: What number comes next when counting: 7, 8, 9, 10, ___?
What number comes next when counting: 5, 6, 7, 8, ___?
What number comes next when counting: 12, 13, 14, 15, ___?
What number comes next when counting: 6, 7, 8, 9, ___?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency's entire point is counting UP TO 1000, but seeds 42-46 only render tiny ranges (7-8-9-10, 5-6-7-8, 17-18-19-20, 12-13-14-15, 6-7-8-9), never approaching hundreds.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All 5 samples are simple +1 sequences confined to single digits and low teens; none demonstrates counting through a hundreds boundary like 198,199,200.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The 'What number comes next when counting: ...' template itself is appropriately simple for Grade 2 Q1 phrasing.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only consecutive +1 counting in the 5-21 range is shown; no sample exercises counting near 999 or across a hundreds/tens rollover that 'up to 1000' implies.

competency_alignment.rationale: As rendered, these samples are indistinguishable from a Grade 1 'count to 20' item; nothing in the text evidences the extended 1000 range this node's vocab (thousand, up to 1000) implies.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The highest number appearing in any of the 5 samples is 21, a severe under-sampling of the stated up-to-1000 range for this competency.
